sloka: कृत्वा तौ सुचिरम् कालम् धर्मिष्ठौ ताः कथाः तदा ।मुदा परमया युक्तौ प्रीयेताम् तौ परस्परम् ॥१-५२-११॥
transliteration: kṛtvā tau suciram kālam dharmiṣṭhau tāḥ kathāḥ tadā ।mudā paramayā yuktau prīyetām tau parasparam ॥1-52-11॥

translations.english: Both the righteous personalities dwelt at length on various matters and interesting anecdotes with great delight and derived mutual pleasure.
